description: Add repos/development-vessel/src/seed/gate-self-probe-tick.ts — create this new seed file exporting a GATE_SELF_PROBE_TICK_TEMPLATE: a deterministic single-resolver wrapper around the live gate_self_probe resolver, following exactly the pattern of POSTERIOR_CONSISTENCY_AUDIT_TICK_TEMPLATE in src/seed/posterior-consistency-audit-tick.ts. Then wire it into src/seed/index.ts: add an import line, an export line, and one entry appended to the SEED_TEMPLATES array. This closes substrate gap gate-self-probe-dispatcher-wiring so the autonomous rotation can invoke the gate self-probe and detect gate regressions.
